name: Minael
source:
Age: 25 (appearance)

Minael is always calm and collected and holds the burden of being a tactician. Although he is on bad terms with Ray and always at odds with him, but deep down they actually acknowledge each other’s skill. He has a much older brother who he is very attached to. His friends among the angels are unaware that it is his brother’s existence that brought about the heavenly war.
[spoiler]Brother of Lucifer.[/spoiler]

[Source: [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.genius.tenshikaigai]Google Play[/url]]
